summary: cors-version fetches and executes remote JavaScript via new Function with require access
details: The CommonJS entry (src/index.cjs) exports getPlugin(), which issues an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded endpoint https://poc-link.vercel.app/ with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false) and passes the response body to new Function('require', data)(require). Invoking the exported helper executes attacker-controlled JavaScript in the caller's Node process with access to require, giving the remote operator full RCE on the installer/host. The package name (cors-version) and stated purpose (zero-dependency SVG utilities) do not correspond, and the ESM build (src/index.mjs) omits getPlugin while the CJS build includes it — selective concealment of the fetch-and-eval sink.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
